---
title: Home
---

A fixture vault whose filenames are *not* already slug-shaped: capitals, spaces,
punctuation, inner dots, apostrophes, non-Latin scripts. The sample vault in
`vault/` is tidy enough that a note's file path and its URL happen to coincide,
which hides a whole class of bug. This one keeps them apart on purpose.

Start at [[Growing Tomatoes]].
